review.verdict: The intended single-ring outcome is preserved, but the requested rotation direction and gap-to-connector alignment are not faithfully demonstrated.
review.method: Compared ten extracted v2 frames with the combined reference, original source-checked plan and exact requests/rotate-rings-v2.json. No continuous playback or listening.
review.first_frame_layout: Preserves the 12-ring network, materials, original headline and typo, IQ 90, tutorial pointer, app icon and Install footer.
review.ring_selection_and_result: Only the intended far-left ring 6 is manipulated and disappears by 7s, with a lower-left release trail. The other 11 rings remain in the same arrangement through 11.5s; no extra ring vanishes or endcard appears.
review.rotation_fidelity: The gap and hand move from the left toward upper-left and then upper-right, which reads as clockwise in the sampled 2–6s sequence instead of the requested 120° counterclockwise drag. Immediately before release, the gap is near the upper-right while the gold coupling is still at the lower-right, so a valid gap/connector alignment is not clearly shown. Exact source angle is not validated by these rendered frames.
review.counters_and_feedback: IQ 90→95 is clear by 7s and stays 95. Orange Good appears at 7s and clears by 8s. The tutorial hand disappears after release.
review.vfx_readability: Metal highlights and the lower-left release streak remain readable without concealing the remaining network. No stretching or cutting of the other rings is apparent in the samples.
review.camera_and_ui_continuity: The network is stable after the early frames. Headline and footer shift slightly from the exact first-frame placement, so the requested screen-locked UI is not pixel-stable; wording and full footer remain readable.

audio.note: AAC presence verified only. The revised exact voiceover, dry mechanical effects, absence of music and synchronization were not listened to or verified.

review.technical_note: Actual video stream 1078×1920; container duration 12.041667s; audio stream 11.968s.
recommended_adjustments: Show the specified counterclockwise rotation and a visible gap-to-connector alignment before releasing the same ring.
Keep headline/footer at the exact first-frame screen positions.
review.limitations: Representative frame review supports the single-ring count and final UI state; it does not prove an executable legal drag or audio compliance. No paid call or retry was made.
